sections.Overview: Latest Version: v2026.11.19 BUG FIX – Fixed automatic Wi-Fi reconnection. SPOOKY SPECTER – Added more Spooky Specter content. SPOOKY SPECTER – Added a QR code so you can share Specter Snapshots from your phone. v2026.10.28 FEATURE – Added Spooky Specters player profiles. Press the action button during attract mode to open Spooky Specters, then press it at ball start to Summon your Specter. FEATURE – Added profile achievements with unlockable avatars, frames, score bars, badges, and rank titles. Completed achievements display a popup and fire the knocker. FEATURE – Added badges for games played, time played, lifetime points, completed Beetlejuice, Sandworm, and Juno modes, multiplayer wins, Now Serving advances, and lost souls returned. Each badge has five tiers: flat, bronze, silver, gold, and holographic. FEATURE – New rank titles can be awarded every 10 levels. FEATURE – Added a Specter inspect screen with profile stats, badge pages, and a scrolling achievement list. Locked rewards show their required achievement. Press the action button to change achievement sorting. FEATURE – High scores now display profile avatars. Players using a Specter skip initials entry. MENU – Added SYSTEM SETTINGS > SPOOKY SPECTERS with ENABLED, DISABLED, and FREEPLAY ONLY options. ENABLED is the default. MENU – Added PROFILE MENU MUSIC and PROFILE MENU SFX settings. MENU – Added a PROFILES service menu page to delete Specters or save them to USB. FEATURE – Fly Swat now ends with a spider gobbling up the fly when time expires. FEATURE – Updated tilt warning text. FEATURE – Tournament Mode disables extra balls and reduces randomness. FEATURE – Minor improvements to Inferno Room. BUG FIX – Improved coin door button handling. BUG FIX – Improved save reliability for scores, settings, and audits. BUG FIX – Adjusted mystery scoop eject power. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue when canceling a game at ball end. BUG FIX – Other minor fixes. v2026.09.15 NEW MODE – Hungry Hungry Sandworms. FEATURE – Multiple improvements to Strange & Unusual. BUG FIX – Improved trough behavior after a failed eject. BUG FIX – Improved recovery from a drop target knockdown failure. v2026.07.20 NEW MODE – Inferno Room. FEATURE – Added Vanity Awards to the game. FEATURE – Added many new Spooky Speak features. FEATURE – Added many new lightshows, including support for the Deadring. FEATURE – Skillshot difficulty now only advances after successfully completing the previous Skillshot. Successfully completing future Skillshots now also awards a +1x score multiplier. FEATURE – Increased Sandworm Battle scoring. FEATURE – Removed the upper limit on the number of hits allowed during Head Shrink Phase 2. FEATURE – Increased the Lost Soul playfield multiplier timer. MENU – Added Spooky Speak voice training to the menu. v2026.06.11 FEATURE – New Mode: Head Shrink. FEATURE – Added new instructional callouts from four different voice actors. These are enabled by default, with menu settings available for adjustment. FEATURE – Sandworm health now resumes from its previous level after a failed attempt. FEATURE – Added an optional Sandworm “stunned” movement animation. This feature is disabled by default and can be enabled in the menu. FEATURE – Added a new ending video for Beetlesnake. FEATURE – Added new speaker and topper lighting patterns throughout the game. FEATURE – Mystery Scoop now advances progress toward the Mystery Award. MENU – Sandworm and target bank now move to the raised position during Switch Test. MENU – Added a setting to clear credits after a reset. MENU – Added a setting to cap the maximum number of Magnet Saves. MENU – Added options to disable select gameplay features. BUG FIX – Bridge servo now cycles at the start of each ball to prevent it from becoming stuck in the raised position. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where the game would not credit up properly on the “Say My Name” screen. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where Spooky Speak could remain active during Attract Mode. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where Showtime Multiball could remain permanently qualified. BUG FIX – Fixed an issue where text could overlap when multiple features were qualified in rapid succession. v2026.04.10 FEATURE – New Mode: Singing In The Stairwell. Complete two modes or start four modes to light this new sub-wizard mode. FEATURE – Selected modes can now be locked or unlocked using the Launch Button. FEATURE – “Jump In The Line” added to Attract Mode. FEATURE – General illumination and lightshow adjustments. MENU – Clearing audits now refreshes the menu page immediately. MENU – Credit cap increased. MENU – Maximum extra balls setting added to System Settings. v2026.03.16 FEATURE – New Beetlejuice Mode: Grave Dig FEATURE – New Beetlejuice Mode: ‘Til Death FEATURE – Right outlane switch now raises the diverter. This is a menu setting. FEATURE – Catherine O’Hare tribute added to attract mode. This is a menu setting. FEATURE – Scoop ejects increase power after failed attempts FEATURE – Charades mode made easier by allowing multiple attempts to find a “match”. FEATURE – Added new video assets to the Soul Scoops FEATURE – Changed end of ball sound effects. MENU – Some ball save settings turned off by default. MENU – Menu setting to allow maximum settings per game. FEATURE – Added additional characters to the Network Password MENU – Network password interface improved. SPOOKY SPEAK – Added the ability to play actions multiple times. BUG FIX – Tweaked debounce settings to better handle pulses from Dollar Bill Validators. BUG FIX – Spooky Speak activation for “Take My Picture” could cause a loop. BUG FIX – Fixed some audio overlap with Ghosts In Sheets BUG FIX – Gameplay audits were not tallying correctly BUG FIX – Slingshot debounce settings tweaked. Launch Code Launch Code
